why: Today's tooling. This is the recheck of the typecheck port's lock fix at 48669b2c30df51c44adc8603f4d5ae7ae32c423e, and both faults I named are fixed. (1) scripts/typecheck/LocksFile.ts:204-211: running reads the label and writes or removes .child (through mark) only while the label names this process, for a command's start and its end alike. (2) scripts/typecheck/LocksFile.ts:121-129: the breaker removes .child before the label. Each fix has a law that reaches it. In a scratch copy of LocksFile.ts, running with no check, and a check on a command's start only, each turned the pinned walk at scripts/typecheck-lock.test.ts:652 red, and the breaker's old order turned the gated scenario at :677 red. N3's new command move stays green under the first plant, so the pinned walk is what guards the displaced case. The race the fix leaves, between running's label read and its .child write, needs the label to change inside that window. A holder that follows the protocol cannot change it: a breaker removes only a stale label, under .break, and a live holder's label is never stale; another process removes only a label naming itself; and this holder's own release runs only after the program's fiber has ended. So that race gives two live holders only through the old 1419 script, the migration window the plan accepts. The bbf5e0e2 merge holds: no line of d480d876's .oxlintrc.json is lost, every block names the same port globs as at 593cb3be, L2 repeats the merged lead-tooling list exactly with main's TomlParser patterns, and the zero lock's audit prints 0 lines. None of my earlier findings was wrong.

plants.plant: running writes and removes .child with no ownership check, in a scratch copy of LocksFile.ts
ownership check on a command's start only; its end removes .child whatever the label names
the breaker removes the label before .child, as the reviewed head did

note: Read-only apart from this row. By reading: CommandsProcess.ts:33 spawns a command and :45 then writes its pid, so a wrapper killed between those two lines leaves a command with no guard. That gap was there before this fix and is not proved by a run, so it has no row.
